articles.title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
articles.summary: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.

articles.titleTr: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
articles.summaryTr: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.
articles.articleText: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda - Published Five EU countries will open a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda next year as part of a broader push to boost removals. Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands are expected to open a "return hub" ready to accept transfers in 2027, the Dutch and Danish governments announced in statements. The countries said the scheme would apply to migrants staying illegally in their nations who are subject to deportation, with the Dutch government adding it will provide an alternative if deportees cannot be returned to their country of origin. Deportees will be able to either integrate into Rwandan society or return to their home country, the nations said. The scheme will apply to people who have exhausted their legal avenues to stay in the five nations - unlike a scrapped British deal that envisaged sending people to Rwanda to have their claims processed. Legal challenges meant the UK deal never took off, and it was eventually junked by the incoming Labour government in 2024. Downing Street has not ruled out the UK joining the scheme, saying they will watch it "with interest". Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said the plan to open a centre in Rwanda had no "future or humanity", according to AFP news agency. "I don't see any future or humanity in that. It's not the solution," Sanchez told the Spanish broadcaster Telecinco, AFP reported. The five countries say the plan to send migrants abroad is in line with EU and international law, but human rights bodies say it could violate migrant rights. The deal follows a recent EU reform that allowed for the creation of hubs outside of the bloc. In a joint press conference in Vienna on Monday, Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker said the five countries wanted to relieve European asylum systems and stop traffickers arranging deadly trips across the Mediterranean. In a written statement, the Dutch government said the five countries will "only return single men" as part of the first phase of the deal, adding that the focus for the Netherlands "will be on persons from countries of origin in the same region as Rwanda". Once in Rwanda, people will be able to integrate into society, which means they will have the right of residence, as well as access to education, healthcare, the labour market and the legal system. Rwandan Interior Minister Vincent Biruta said the country is commmited to working with European partners to provide a "safe, legal and dignified solution for migrants". He added that they would also work on "correcting the global imbalance in economic opportunities", which he called a "key driver of irregular migration". Ahead of the announcement, diplomatic sources told the AFP news agency the hub is expected to initially run as a pilot, hosting about 100 people, with each of the five nations possibly sending about 20 migrants. The United Nations' International Organisation for Migration (IOM) could play an ancillary role. "IOM has a long history of providing assistance to migrants in situations of transit, including in complex contexts," an IOM spokesperson said, adding the agency was in discussions with some EU countries "on plans for the establishment of return hubs or similar mechanisms". With elections approaching in several EU nations, administrations have been under pressure to show they can control migration. Concerns around security, struggling economies and disillusionment with governing parties have all had a major role in shaping attitudes towards people leaving their home countries. Human Rights Watch's senior Africa researcher Clementine de Montjoye said the choice of Rwanda would be a cause of concern as it had a "well-established record of repression of dissent, arbitrary detention, ill-treatment in detention" and support for armed rebels in the neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo. "Paying Kigali to host a deportation programme would not only cause suffering and harm to those deported, it would finance and provide political leverage to a government responsible for serious human rights abuses at home and abroad." The independent EU Agency for Fundamental Rights argued any third country hosting a return hub should "respect fundamental rights", including that people should not be sent to a country where they face serious risk of persecution. The agency added that unaccompanied children should not be sent to a return hub, which the Dutch government has confirmed will not take place. According to the European Border and Coast Guard Agency, there were almost 110,000 irregular border crossings into the EU in the first 10 months of 2026, which represents a 29% decrease compared to the previous year. In October, about 18,100 crossings were detected, which is about 6% less than October 2025 but 22% more than in September "largely because of a sharp rise in arrivals on the Western African route to the Canary Islands". articles.titleTr: Customers report service outages at major US banks
articles.summaryTr: Chase Bank, the largest US bank, said a software bug might be causing the issue, but that it was not "systemic'" or "cyber-related".
articles.articleText: Customers report service outages at major US banks - Published Thousands of customers at major US banks, including JP Morgan Chase, Wells Fargo and Bank of America, have reported trouble accessing services. Chase Bank - the largest banking institution in the US - said a "software bug" in its hardware systems may have been behind the glitch and noted the impacts may have affected other banks. It added the issue was "temporary" and not "systemic" or "cyber-related". Problems appeared to be easing for many customers by early Monday evening. The issue comes after a string of unrelated technical problems last week, including a massive Microsoft outage, as well as a telecommunications issue and network failure that grounded all US flights. Problems started throughout the afternoon on Monday. There were almost 5,000 reports of Chase Bank's services being down, according to the Downdetector website. Chase Bank told it's customers that "some transactions are taking longer than usual to complete" but they still had "access to their accounts and funds". The bank, a subsidiary of JP Morgan Chase, serves more than 86m customers at 5,000 branches across the US, as well as 7.4m small businesses, according to the company's webpage. It is also the top credit card issuer in the US. The exact nature of the bug was unclear. The BBC has contacted Chase Bank. Another institution, US Bank, said some its systems were not directly affected but clients using the Zelle, a digital payment platform, received error messages saying their payments could not be sent. Zelle has said its service is "operating as it should" and issues at other banks could be affecting payments. Customers also reported issues with Truist, PNC and Capital One but all these companies told the BBC they have not been impacted. As of 1800 ET (2300G), Chase, Bank of America and US Bank had seen a fall in the number of reported outages.

articles.title: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack
articles.summary: Attorney General Rob Bonta alleges OpenAI misled and endangered the public

articles.titleTr: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack
articles.summaryTr: Attorney General Rob Bonta alleges OpenAI misled and endangered the public
articles.articleText: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack - Published California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI on Monday, alleging the ChatGPT-maker misled and endangered the public by developing artificial intelligence (AI) models without proper safeguards. In the lawsuit, Bonta cited the July 2026 attack on the AI platform Hugging Face by experimental OpenAI agents which accessed the internet to breach that company's internal systems. Bonta claimed OpenAI created a public nuisance and violated the state's unfair competition laws. OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri told the BBC in a statement that Bonta's lawsuit "appears to single out OpenAI over a challenge that's been identified by every major AI lab". Other major AI developers including Anthropic, Meta, and Google have also said their models have staged similar attacks. But Bonta's lawsuit, filed in San Francisco, where the company is headquartered, appears to be the first such suit filed by a US state. Hundreds of OpenAI agents coordinated the Hugging Face attack over two days even though they were supposed to be contained in a safe testing environment. The incident drew added scrutiny because the agents went as far as attempting to cover their tracks. Bonta announced an investigation into the incident in September, and served an investigative subpoena on OpenAI as part of its probe. "The company knowingly tested a dangerous product without proper oversight or safety procedures and misled the public about it - this disregard for public safety violated California law," Bonta said in a statement on Monday. OpenAI said it has been transparent and responsive to the Attorney General's office. "We take misalignment seriously, and we have engaged - and will continue to engage - constructively with the Attorney General's office to share information and advance strong, practical safety standards for the entire industry," the company said. The company added that, since the Hugging Face incident, it has worked to understand and address "misaligned model activity" which industry figures often refer to as rogue agents. Nathan Calvin, chief strategy officer at AI safety campaign group Encode AI, said the lawsuit "recognises something we at Encode have long raised alarms about". "OpenAI and other companies developing frontier AI systems have safety and security practices that are insufficient to protect the public from risks that could be catastrophic," he said. articles.titleTr: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
articles.summaryTr: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.
articles.articleText: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand. The United States Supreme Court on Monday declined to hear an appeal from crypto-focused bank Custodia, effectively ending the bank’s latest legal effort to gain direct access to the Federal Reserve’s payment system. Custodia is a Wyoming-chartered bank founded by Caitlin Long. The bank has been trying for a Fed master account since 2020, which would allow it to process payments directly without relying on third-party financial institutions. Now, the Supreme Court’s Monday decision means an earlier ruling allowing the Fed to reject applications from eligible banks will remain in effect. The case highlights some of the challenges crypto-facing banks face in gaining direct access to the US payment system. Still, even if state-chartered banks qualify for master accounts, the Fed does not have to approve every application. In a dissent issued in March, US Circuit Judge Timothy Tymkovich criticized the appeals court’s decision to give Federal Reserve banks discretion over master accounts. “Without a master account, a bank cannot operate in the modern banking system,” Tymkovich wrote, arguing that the ruling effectively gives the Fed the power to override state banking decisions. A timeline of events Custodia first sued the Federal Reserve in 2022 after waiting around two years for a decision on its master account application. The Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City ended up rejecting the request in January 2023, citing concerns about risks linked to the bank’s crypto-focused business model. In October 2025, a federal appeals court ruled against Custodia, finding that Federal Reserve banks did not have to grant master accounts to every eligible institution. Related: Crypto among sectors ‘debanked’ by 9 major banks: US regulator Cointelegraph previously reported that the court declined to reconsider its decision in March. This led Custodia to take its case to the Supreme Court. The bank’s appeal also received support from the Blockchain Association, which argued that the Fed’s ability to reject applications could weaken the authority of state banking regulators. Senator Cynthia Lummis and former Senator Patrick Toomey also filed a brief with the Supreme Court in August, supporting Custodia’s appeal. articles.summaryTr: United Airlines, yaygın bir sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini açıkladı. Uçuş halindeki uçakların ve United Express seferlerinin etkilenmediği belirtilirken, şirket siber saldırı ihtimaline ilişkin bir bulgu olmadığını bildirdi.
articles.articleText: ABD'de uçuş kabusu yeniden başladı: Havacılık devi United Airlines'ın sistemleri çöktü - United Airlines, yaygın bir sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini açıkladı. Uçuş halindeki uçakların ve United Express seferlerinin etkilenmediği belirtilirken, şirket siber saldırı ihtimaline ilişkin bir bulgu olmadığını bildirdi. ABD'li hava yolu şirketi United Airlines, pazartesi günü yaşanan geniş çaplı sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketten yapılan açıklamada, kalkış seferlerini etkileyen bir teknoloji sorununun giderilmesi için çalışmaların sürdüğü belirtildi. United Airlines, arızanın havada bulunan uçakları ve United Express uçuşlarını etkilemediğini bildirdi. Siber saldırı bulgusuna rastlanmadı United Airlines sözcüsü, yaşanan sistem kesintisinin bir siber saldırı olduğuna ilişkin herhangi bir bulgu bulunmadığını açıkladı. Şirket, sosyal medya platformu X üzerinden yaptığı paylaşımda teknik ekiplerin sistemleri mümkün olan en kısa sürede yeniden çalışır hale getirmek için yoğun çaba gösterdiğini belirtti. Yolculardan uçuş durumlarını düzenli olarak kontrol etmeleri istendi. ABD'de üç gün önce ülke genelinde uçuşlar durmuştu United Airlines'taki sistem arızası, ABD genelinde uçuşların dört saatten uzun süre durmasına neden olan ülke çapındaki yer durdurma kararından yalnızca üç gün sonra yaşandı. 13 Kasım'daki aksaklık, hafta sonu boyunca geniş çaplı uçuş gecikmelerine ve iptallerine yol açmıştı. ABD Ulaştırma Bakanı Sean Duffy, önceki kesintinin Arkansas'taki bir yönlendiricinin hava trafik kontrol sistemlerine radar ve diğer verileri ileten altyapıyı aşırı yüklemesinden kaynaklandığını söylemişti. Federal Havacılık İdaresi (FAA) yöneticisi Bryan Bedford ise bakır kablolardan fiber optik altyapıya geçiş için yapılan çalışmaların rutin bakım kapsamında gerçekleştirildiğini açıklamıştı. FlightAware verilerine göre pazartesi günü uçuş gecikmeleri ve iptalleri, pazar gününe kıyasla önemli ölçüde azaldı.

articles.title: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases
articles.summary: Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases
articles.summaryTr: Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation.
articles.articleText: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation. Germany’s lower house of parliament has passed a bill that would let customs authorities temporarily freeze cryptocurrency and other high-value assets suspected of having unlawful origins without first opening a criminal investigation. The Bundestag passed the customs reform bill on Friday as part of a wider effort to combat money laundering and organized crime. The proposed procedure would target assets worth more than 100,000 euros and explicitly mentions cryptocurrencies. Under the bill’s text approved by lawmakers, authorities would be able to hold assets for up to 30 days where there are factual indications of unlawful origins, according to a translated version. However, filing an application for confiscation could suspend those deadlines pending a court decision, and in contested cases, a court would have to be satisfied that the assets were of unlawful origin before ordering confiscation, effectively putting the burden of proof on the crypto holder. German Social Democratic Party lawmaker Ingo Vogel said that the powers would allow authorities to pursue suspicious assets even when there are not yet grounds to open a criminal case, according to the Bundestag’s summary of the debate on the bill. The bill still requires consent from the Bundesrat, Germany’s upper house of parliament, and is intended to take effect on Jan. 1, 2027. Lawyers challenge asset seizure powers Germany’s Federal Bar Association, known as BRAK, previously opposed the government’s draft in an Oct. 28 statement, warning that the meaning of unlawful origin is too vague and risks treating missing records as evidence of illicit wealth. The association pointed to assets inherited through generations as one example where owners may lack a paper trail. It also questioned what the administrative process would add to Germany’s existing criminal confiscation rules. German blockchain industry association Bundesblock also raised concerns about the treatment of digital assets in a March 31 submission on an earlier draft. It warned at the time that blockchain analysis should not automatically be treated as proof of ownership or control, and that incorrect wallet attribution could even infringe fundamental rights. Related: Crypto adoption blooming in Germany, while UK is falling ‘behind,’ says CoinShares researcher Movie2k judge proposes Bitcoin deal Germany has already carried out large crypto seizures under existing law. As Cointelegraph reported, Saxony authorities sold 49,858 Bitcoin (BTC) linked to the Movie2k piracy investigation in 2024, raising about 2.6 billion euros, or $2.8 billion. At the time, prosecutors said the proceeds remained secured pending a court ruling on confiscation. In a recent development, local outlet MDR reported on Friday that a Leipzig judge proposed ending proceedings against the main defendant in exchange for 40,000 BTC and a payment of 38 million euros for the potential victims. The proposal remains under consideration. Magazine: US sellers drive Bitcoin crash, Jensen plots Nvidia comeback: Hodler’s Digest

articles.title: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO
articles.summary: A number of tech figures have backed an effort asking the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO
articles.summaryTr: A number of tech figures have backed an effort asking the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.
articles.articleText: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO - Published Nvidia has dismissed a campaign calling for Jensen Huang to be handed back his job as allies, including US President Donald Trump, backed the effort. Trump said on Monday that he "would certainly not mind" if Huang was reinstated, adding to a list of supporters who are backing a "Bring Jensen Back" campaign. Fellow tech bosses, including SpaceX's Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney, chief executive of Fortnite-maker Epic Games, have also supported Huang's return. But the BBC has been told the board of the AI chip giant is not interested in bringing him back after he resigned last week following revelations he had two affairs, including one that involved a suspected Chinese spy. Meanwhile on Monday, the Trump administration said it will further restrict China's access to AI chips from companies like Nvidia. The reported affairs created a crisis for one of the world's most valuable firms - a central company in AI and the US battle against China for dominance. Since his departure, supporters have launched an online petition demanding his return. Musk and Sweeny are among the more than 175,000 who have signed the open letter calling for the board to reinstate Huang while an ongoing internal probe is conducted. The "Stand with Jensen" campaign claims to have been launched by a make up of current and former Nvidia employees, partners, shareholders and supporters, all demanding the return of the former chief executive. They expressed concerns the ex-Nvidia boss "was removed without meaningful due process". President Trump gave his views on Huang's future on Monday, saying he "would certainly not mind" seeing the former boss given his job back. "I guess maybe one lesson is more important than another, but I would certainly not mind seeing that," he told reporters as he left the White House. The Trump administration on Monday also issued new restrictions on chip exports to overseas data centres, which allow Chinese companies to access advanced AI chips to train AI models. The move came ahead of Trump's meeting with Chinese President Xi Jingping this week. The new rules will require companies in Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia and Brazil to apply for US export licences for the most advanced chips in an effort to cut down on them being illegally diverted to China. Huang had been expected to weather the storm following the revelation of an affair involving Alice Huang, alleged to be a Chinese spy. However, he resigned last Thursday after a second extra-marital relationship emerged, allegedly with an executive at Nvidia who reported to him. The scandal-hit tech boss was discussing a possible return to Nvidia with confidants, according to the Financial Times, external, though Nvidia's board is not considering reappointing him. A representative for Huang declined to comment on the report. The so-called war room also wants to get support for Huang from the White House. President Trump has spoken in glowing terms about Huang since the scandal erupted, and also said he believed Huang when the former Nvidia boss told him he had "no idea she was a spy". Trump's view is at odds with his Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who has called for Nvidia to hire its next chief executive from outside the company. The scandal has created tensions between the US Treasury and Commerce departments over shipments of high-end Nvidia chips to Alice Huang's former firm, Megaspeed. China has denied that Alice Huang is a spy. It has raised questions about the possibility that the chips may have ended up in China despite US export restrictions. 'China plays games with us, so we play games with China' On Monday, Trump said he did not know whether the women Huang had an affair with was a spy for China. "They say she's a spy. I don't know that she was a spy at all. I mean, I really don't, I don't know that," he said. Huang has agreed to testify in Congress, including before the House Select Committee on China to discuss whether US national security was compromised by his affair. Trump said he did not think Huang had put national security at risk. "You know, China plays games with us. So we play games with China," he said. The FBI is also investigating the affair between the former Nvidia boss and Alice Huang, according to Trump. 'A handshake with Jensen' Musk claimed that "critical deals" involving Nvidia's technology would be lost following Huang's resignation. "Jensen drove supply chain brilliantly at Nvidia but many of those deals were a handshake with Jensen, not a written contract," he posted on X., external "Without Jensen, at least some of those critical deals will be lost." Fellow tech boss Sam Altman, the chief executive of OpenAI, sidestepped the question of Huang returning to Nvidia at a conference, saying: "I don't think I know enough to answer that question." But Altman, who himself was reinstated to his job after being fired back in 2023, said Huang was a "hero of mine". Shareholders in Nvidia also want Huang back at the company's helm. Hundreds of billions of pounds have been wiped off the firm's stock market value in recent days, but it is still worth some $3.87 trillion. Its share price was down in early Monday trading. In an open letter to the board, Brad Gerstner, founder of Altimeter Capital and Atreides Management boss Gavin Baker called for management to leave "all options on the table, including the potential return of Jensen Huang". Lord Sarfraz, a member of the UK's House of Lords, has also written to Nvidia's new chair, Harvey Jones, urging the firm's directors to give "serious consideration" to Huang's return following the investigation. For the moment, Nvidia's chief financial officer Colette Kress is leading the firm and will present the company's results on Tuesday. - Published21 hours ago

The scandal-hit tech boss was discussing a possible return to Nvidia with confidants, according to the Financial Times, external, though Nvidia's board is not considering reappointing him. A representative for Huang declined to comment on the report. The so-called war room also wants to get support for Huang from the White House. President Trump has spoken in glowing terms about Huang since the scandal erupted, and also said he believed Huang when the former Nvidia boss told him he had "no idea she was a spy". Trump's view is at odds with his Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who has called for Nvidia to hire its next chief executive from outside the company. The scandal has created tensions between the US Treasury and Commerce departments over shipments of high-end Nvidia chips to Alice Huang's former firm, Megaspeed. China has denied that Alice Huang is a spy. It has raised questions about the possibility that the chips may have ended up in China despite US export restrictions. 'China plays games with us, so we play games with China' On Monday, Trump said he did not know whether the women Huang had an affair with was a spy for China. "They say she's a spy. I don't know that she was a spy at all. I mean, I really don't, I don't know that," he said. Huang has agreed to testify in Congress, including before the House Select Committee on China to discuss whether US national security was compromised by his affair. Trump said he did not think Huang had put national security at risk. "You know, China plays games with us. So we play games with China," he said. The FBI is also investigating the affair between the former Nvidia boss and Alice Huang, according to Trump. 'A handshake with Jensen' Musk claimed that "critical deals" involving Nvidia's technology would be lost following Huang's resignation. "Jensen drove supply chain brilliantly at Nvidia but many of those deals were a handshake with Jensen, not a written contract," he posted on X., external "Without Jensen, at least some of those critical deals will be lost." Fellow tech boss Sam Altman, the chief executive of OpenAI, sidestepped the question of Huang returning to Nvidia at a conference, saying: "I don't think I know enough to answer that question." But Altman, who himself was reinstated to his job after being fired back in 2023, said Huang was a "hero of mine". Shareholders in Nvidia also want Huang back at the company's helm. Hundreds of billions of pounds have been wiped off the firm's stock market value in recent days, but it is still worth some $3.87 trillion. Its share price was down in early Monday trading. In an open letter to the board, Brad Gerstner, founder of Altimeter Capital and Atreides Management boss Gavin Baker called for management to leave "all options on the table, including the potential return of Jensen Huang". Lord Sarfraz, a member of the UK's House of Lords, has also written to Nvidia's new chair, Harvey Jones, urging the firm's directors to give "serious consideration" to Huang's return following the investigation. For the moment, Nvidia's chief financial officer Colette Kress is leading the firm and will present the company's results on Tuesday. - Published21 hours ago

articles.articleText: Fon soruşturmasında 21 şirkete TMSF kayyumu atandı: Usulsüz kredi ve para aklama... - İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının yürüttüğü fon soruşturması kapsamında Ali Emre Ballı ve İlkay Ballı'nın ortaklık paylarının bulunduğu 21 şirkete TMSF yönetim kayyumu olarak atandı. Şirketlerden 15'inin aktif olduğu açıklandı. Sermaye piyasası işlemlerine ilişkin yürütülen fon soruşturmasında önemli bir gelişme yaşandı. İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, Ali Emre Ballı ve İlkay Ballı'nın ortaklık paylarının bulunduğu 21 şirkete Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonunun (TMSF) yönetim kayyumu olarak atanmasına karar verildiğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Başsavcılığın açıklamasına göre karar, Mali Suçları Araştırma Kurulu Başkanlığından (MASAK) alınan raporlar, bilirkişi analizleri ve alınan beyanlar doğrultusunda verildi. Usulsüz kredi ve para aklama tespitleri Soruşturma kapsamında Ali Emre Ballı ve İlkay Ballı'nın taşınır ve taşınmaz varlıkları, banka hesapları, elektronik para kuruluşlarındaki varlıkları, kiralık kasaları ve şirket ortaklık payları hakkında el koyma kararı alındı. Başsavcılık açıklamasında, usulsüz krediler alınarak şirket kaynaklarının tüketildiği, ters repo işlemleriyle risk açığının büyütüldüğü ve suçtan elde edilen değerlerin çeşitli işlemlere tabi tutularak aklandığının tespit edildiği belirtildi. Bu kapsamda, maddi gerçeğin ortaya çıkarılması amacıyla 21 şirketin yönetim organlarının yetkilerinin TMSF'ye devredilmesine karar verildi. Karar kapsamında TMSF'ye, şirketlerin yönetim yetkilerinin yanı sıra ortaklık payları veya menkul kıymetleri idare etme yetkileri de verildi. Kayyum atanan 15 aktif şirketin isimleri açıklandı Kayyum atanan 21 şirketten 6'sının tasfiye halinde olduğu, 15'inin ise aktif durumda bulunduğu bildirildi. TMSF'nin yönetim kayyumu olarak atandığı aktif şirketler şöyle sıralandı: - Online Teknoloji ve Danışmanlık AŞ - Online Yönetim Yazılım Bilişim Sistemleri AŞ - Reel Finansal Teknoloji Yazılımları Ali Emre Ballı Mustafa Yazıcı Kolektif Şirketi - Online Telekom Telekomünikasyon Hizmetleri Ticaret Ltd. Şti. - İntime İnfo Yazılım Çözümleri AŞ - Fair Finansman AŞ - Online Filo Araç Kiralama AŞ - Mülksa Gayrimenkul Danışmanlık Hizmetleri AŞ - Divissa Teknoloji AŞ - Fair Finansal Kiralama AŞ - Online Finansal Danışmanlık AŞ - Sentez Araç Kiralama Sanayi ve Ticaret AŞ - Cemre İletişim Sistemleri Telekomünikasyon Sanayi ve Dış Ticaret Ltd. Şti. - Tekpa Teknolojik Ürünler Pazarlama ve Dış Ticaret Ltd. Şti. - Online Gayrimenkul Geliştirme ve Ticaret AŞ Başsavcılık açıklamasında, kayyum kararının 7596 sayılı Kanun ile Ceza Muhakemesi Kanunu'nun 133'üncü maddesi kapsamında alındığı bildirildi.

articles.summaryTr: ABD'li çip üreticisi Intel'e, PC pazarındaki yavaşlamayı ve tedarik sorunlarını yatırımcılardan gizlediği iddiasıyla dava açıldı. Şirketin CEO'su Lip-Bu Tan ve CFO'su David Zinsner de davada sanık olarak gösterildi.
articles.articleText: Intel'e yatırımcıları yanılttığı iddiasıyla toplu dava: CEO ve CFO da davalılar arasında - ABD'li çip üreticisi Intel'e, PC pazarındaki yavaşlamayı ve tedarik sorunlarını yatırımcılardan gizlediği iddiasıyla dava açıldı. Şirketin CEO'su Lip-Bu Tan ve CFO'su David Zinsner de davada sanık olarak gösterildi. ABD'li çip üreticisi Intel, yatırımcıları yanıltıcı açıklamalarla zarara uğrattığı iddiasıyla toplu davayla karşı karşıya kaldı. Southfield İtfaiye ve Polis Emeklilik Sistemi'nin öncülüğünde açılan davada, Intel Üst Yöneticisi (CEO) Lip-Bu Tan ve Finans Direktörü (CFO) David Zinsner de davalılar arasında yer aldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle California Kuzey Bölge Mahkemesi'ne sunulan dava dilekçesinde, Intel'in 23 Temmuz-29 Ekim 2026 döneminde şirketin adi hisse senetlerini satın alan yatırımcıları yanıltıcı açıklamalarla zarara uğrattığı öne sürüldü. PC pazarındaki yavaşlamayı gizlemekle suçlanıyor Dava dilekçesinde, Intel yöneticilerinin yapay zeka kaynaklı talep artışı ve veri merkezlerine yönelik sunucu işlemcisi satışlarının şirketin büyümesini desteklediğine ilişkin olumlu açıklamalar yaptığı belirtildi. Buna karşın PC pazarındaki yavaşlamanın boyutunun, iş ortaklarında biriken ihtiyaç fazlası stokların ve üretimi kısıtlayan tedarik sorunlarının yatırımcılara açıklanmadığı iddia edildi. Davacı taraf, şirket yönetiminin bu gelişmelere ilişkin yeterli bilgilendirme yapmayarak yatırımcıları yanıltıcı açıklamalarda bulunduğunu savundu. 23 milyar dolarlık hisse satışı da dava dilekçesinde Dilekçede, Intel'in 12 Ağustos'ta hisse başına 95 dolardan 240 milyondan fazla hisse sattığı ve bu işlemden yaklaşık 23 milyar dolar brüt gelir elde ettiği bilgisine de yer verildi. Davacı taraf, söz konusu hisse satışının davalıların yatırımcıları yanıltmak için motivasyon ve fırsata sahip olduğu iddiasını desteklediğini öne sürdü. Mahkemeden davanın toplu dava olarak görülmesini ve yatırımcıların uğradığı zararların tazmin edilmesini talep etti. Intel hisselerinde bir günde yüzde 28,6'lık kayıp Intel, 29 Ekim'de açıkladığı 2026'nın üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarında, PC faaliyetlerini kapsayan İstemci Bilişim ve Fiziksel Yapay Zeka Grubu (CCPG) segmentinin gelirinin yıllık bazda yüzde 5 azalarak 8,1 milyar dolara gerilediğini bildirmişti. Şirketin dördüncü çeyrek için 15-16 milyar dolar aralığında açıkladığı gelir beklentisi ve hisse başına 25 sentlik kâr öngörüsü, analist tahminlerinin altında kalmıştı. Intel hisseleri, 29 Ekim'de 92,07 dolardan kapanmasının ardından 30 Ekim'de yüzde 28,6 değer kaybederek 65,76 dolara gerilemişti. Bu düşüşle şirketin piyasa değerinden yaklaşık 140 milyar dolar silinmişti.

PC pazarındaki yavaşlamayı gizlemekle suçlanıyor Dava dilekçesinde, Intel yöneticilerinin yapay zeka kaynaklı talep artışı ve veri merkezlerine yönelik sunucu işlemcisi satışlarının şirketin büyümesini desteklediğine ilişkin olumlu açıklamalar yaptığı belirtildi. Buna karşın PC pazarındaki yavaşlamanın boyutunun, iş ortaklarında biriken ihtiyaç fazlası stokların ve üretimi kısıtlayan tedarik sorunlarının yatırımcılara açıklanmadığı iddia edildi. Davacı taraf, şirket yönetiminin bu gelişmelere ilişkin yeterli bilgilendirme yapmayarak yatırımcıları yanıltıcı açıklamalarda bulunduğunu savundu. 23 milyar dolarlık hisse satışı da dava dilekçesinde Dilekçede, Intel'in 12 Ağustos'ta hisse başına 95 dolardan 240 milyondan fazla hisse sattığı ve bu işlemden yaklaşık 23 milyar dolar brüt gelir elde ettiği bilgisine de yer verildi. Davacı taraf, söz konusu hisse satışının davalıların yatırımcıları yanıltmak için motivasyon ve fırsata sahip olduğu iddiasını desteklediğini öne sürdü. Mahkemeden davanın toplu dava olarak görülmesini ve yatırımcıların uğradığı zararların tazmin edilmesini talep etti. Intel hisselerinde bir günde yüzde 28,6'lık kayıp Intel, 29 Ekim'de açıkladığı 2026'nın üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarında, PC faaliyetlerini kapsayan İstemci Bilişim ve Fiziksel Yapay Zeka Grubu (CCPG) segmentinin gelirinin yıllık bazda yüzde 5 azalarak 8,1 milyar dolara gerilediğini bildirmişti. Şirketin dördüncü çeyrek için 15-16 milyar dolar aralığında açıkladığı gelir beklentisi ve hisse başına 25 sentlik kâr öngörüsü, analist tahminlerinin altında kalmıştı. Intel hisseleri, 29 Ekim'de 92,07 dolardan kapanmasının ardından 30 Ekim'de yüzde 28,6 değer kaybederek 65,76 dolara gerilemişti. Bu düşüşle şirketin piyasa değerinden yaklaşık 140 milyar dolar silinmişti.

articles.title: Houthi rebel advance in Yemen may further destabilise global economy
articles.summary: The Iran-backed Houthis are gaining ground and their advance could have dangerous consequences, writes the BBC's security correspondent.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Houthi rebel advance in Yemen may further destabilise global economy
articles.summaryTr: The Iran-backed Houthis are gaining ground and their advance could have dangerous consequences, writes the BBC's security correspondent.
articles.articleText: Houthi rebel advance in Yemen may further destabilise global economy - Published The Iran-backed Houthi rebels who seized much of Yemen in 2014 have now forced the army of the internationally recognised government to withdraw from the Red Sea coast in order to defend their interim capital, Aden. Their advance bodes ill for Yemen's legitimate, internationally recognised government, its Saudi backers and, by extension, much of the rest of the world. Yemen, a mountainous, heavily armed, intensely tribal and largely impoverished nation, sits at the far south-west corner of the Arabian Peninsula. The country has two coasts: One faces the Indian Ocean on which sits the once-prosperous trading port of Aden, the other faces the Red Sea and, most importantly, the narrow chokepoint at the southern exit of that waterway - the so-called Bab al-Mandab Strait or, in English, The Gate of Tears. Whoever controls that strait can threaten any or all maritime traffic passing through from both the Mediterranean and the Red Sea to the Indian Ocean. In normal times, it accounts for around 12% of global trade, with anywhere between 70 to 150 ships a day making the transit. But not any more. Although the Houthis say they are no threat to maritime traffic, they are currently at war with Saudi Arabia, making it extremely hazardous for the Saudis to send their oil tankers past the now rebel-controlled coast. When the US and Israel started a war with Iran in February, Tehran responded by choking off much of the oil trade flowing out of the Gulf through another narrow chokepoint - the Strait of Hormuz. This sent oil prices soaring, boosted inflation and hurt economies everywhere. The Saudis had a Plan B. Instead of exporting their oil past the dangerous coast of Iran, where their tankers risked being droned or mined by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps, they started pumping it overland through their East-West Pipeline to an export terminal on the Red Sea at Yanbu. This worked for a while. But then in July a cold truce between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis broke down, that pipeline got hit by drones and the rebels started firing missiles and drones at targets all over Saudi Arabia. On land, the Houthis seized the initiative and made a lightning dash down the Red Sea coast, sending the Yemeni army into headlong retreat. A brief counter-offensive appears to have failed and the Houthis are now reported to be in full control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait and the nearby offshore islands. Nicholas Hopton, a former British Ambassador to both Yemen and Iran and now director-general of the UK-based Middle East Association, says: "The decision by the legitimate government of Yemen to prioritise the military defence of Aden at the expense of withdrawing from other areas suggests that the war is not going well for the Saudi-backed [Yemeni] government. And the rest of the world should be worried." He warns that if the port of Aden – a city of roughly 1.25 million inhabitants – was to fall to the Houthis, it "would undoubtedly precipitate a further escalation in the regional crisis and further fragility in the global economy, catalysed by the US-Iran war". But Mohammed al-Basha, the Yemeni founder of the US-based risk advisory firm Basha Report, believes the Houthis would struggle to capture the heavily fortified city of Aden. "Any attempt to seize a densely populated city like Aden would come at a significant human cost," Basha said. "Advancing across the flat coastal plains would also expose Houthi forces to air power." "For now, the Houthis appear to be seeking a negotiated surrender, hoping to exploit infighting and divisions among southern factions to achieve their objectives without a costly urban offensive." It is conceivable that the Yemen war will settle into a less dramatic but deeply unsatisfactory stasis - a situation where casualty figures subside yet the country remains split between areas controlled by the Houthis - Iran's Shia allies - and the disparate and often poorly motivated forces of the Saudi-backed Yemeni army. The former British defence attaché to Yemen, Col Iain Smailes, warned that the recent Houthi advance could trigger a spike in oil prices, as it did when they seized the Bab al-Mandab Strait in September. He also warns this could have a knock-on effect to security well beyond Yemen's borders. "By extending their control over the western coastline, the Houthis will increase their ability to smuggle weapons and ammunition from Iran, the Horn of Africa and elsewhere, posing additional threats to the region," Col Smailes said. "This control will enable both Iran and the Houthis to extend their influence in East Africa and beyond." - Published12 hours ago - Published13 October - Published12 October

articles.titleTr: ABD borsalarında sert satış: Nvidia öncülüğündeki düşüş üçüncü güne taşındı
articles.summaryTr: ABD borsalarında yapay zeka hisseleri öncülüğünde satış baskısı arttı. Nasdaq yüzde 2,49, S&P 500 yüzde 1,91 gerilerken Dow Jones 737 puan kaybetti. Nvidia hisseleri ise yüzde 4'ün üzerinde düştü.
articles.articleText: ABD borsalarında sert satış: Nvidia öncülüğündeki düşüş üçüncü güne taşındı - ABD borsalarında yapay zeka hisseleri öncülüğünde satış baskısı arttı. Nasdaq yüzde 2,49, S&P 500 yüzde 1,91 gerilerken Dow Jones 737 puan kaybetti. Nvidia hisseleri ise yüzde 4'ün üzerinde düştü. ABD borsaları haftanın ilk işlem gününü sert düşüşle tamamladı. Yapay zeka sektöründeki belirsizlikler ve Nvidia cephesinden gelen gelişmeler teknoloji hisselerinde satışları hızlandırırken, Nasdaq endeksi düşüşünü üçüncü işlem gününe taşıdı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Nasdaq Composite endeksi yüzde 2,49 gerilerken, S&P 500 yüzde 1,91 değer kaybetti. Dow Jones Sanayi Endeksi ise 737 puanlık düşüşle günü yüzde 1,41 ekside tamamladı. Nvidia'daki belirsizlik teknoloji hisselerini baskıladı Nvidia hisseleri yüzde 4'ün üzerinde değer kaybetti. CNBC'ye konuşan konuya yakın bir kaynak, şirketin yönetim kurulunun Jensen Huang'ı CEO'luğa geri getirmeyi görüşmediğini söyledi. Satış baskısını artıran bir diğer gelişme ise ABD Ticaret Bakanlığı'nın, Çinli şirketlerin başka ülkelerde bulunan Nvidia işlem gücünü kiralamasına olanak tanıyan bir boşluğu kapatmaya yönelik adım atması oldu. ABD Hazine Bakanı Scott Bessent de hafta sonunda Nvidia yönetim kuruluna şirket dışından yeni bir CEO arayışına girmesi çağrısında bulunmuştu. FBB Capital Partners Baş Yatırım Sorumlusu Mike Mussio, yatırımcıların Nvidia konusunda daha önce güvenli gördükleri görünümün değiştiğini belirterek şirketin geleceğine ilişkin yanıt bekleyen çok sayıda soru bulunduğunu söyledi. Gözler Nvidia'nın bilançosunda Nvidia, salı günü piyasa kapanışının ardından üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını açıklayacak. Analistler şirketin gelir ve kârında yıllık bazda yaklaşık yüzde 100 büyüme bekliyor. Ancak yatırımcıların odağında yalnızca finansal sonuçlar bulunmuyor. Jensen Huang'ın CEO'luk görevinden ayrılmasının ardından şirketin nasıl bir yol izleyeceği de yakından takip ediliyor. Huang'ın geçen hafta görevinden ayrılmasının ardından Nvidia hisseleri yüzde 13 gerilemiş ve Nisan 2025'ten bu yana en sert haftalık düşüşünü kaydetmişti. Freedom Capital Markets Baş Piyasa Stratejisti Jay Woods, güçlü finansal sonuçların Huang'ın ayrılığıyla ilgili soru işaretlerini ortadan kaldırmayacağını belirtti. Woods, 33 yıl boyunca tek bir CEO tarafından yönetilen şirketin artık bu isim olmadan da büyümesini sürdürebileceğini göstermesi gerektiğini ifade etti. Yapay zeka hisselerinde satış dalgası yayıldı Nvidia'daki düşüş, diğer çip ve teknoloji şirketlerine de yansıdı. Micron Technology ve Intel hisseleri yaklaşık yüzde 7, AMD yüzde 5, Sandisk ise yaklaşık yüzde 8 geriledi. Bilgisayar üreticisi Dell Technologies'in hisseleri yüzde 7 değer kaybederken, Oracle hisselerinde düşüş yüzde 5'e ulaştı. Satışlar ilerleyen saatlerde yapay zeka şirketlerinin dışına da yayıldı. Finans sektöründe Morgan Stanley ve Goldman Sachs yaklaşık yüzde 3 gerilerken, JPMorgan Chase yüzde 2'nin üzerinde değer kaybetti. Anthropic halka arzı da yakından izleniyor Yapay zeka sektörünün bu haftaki bir diğer önemli gündemi Anthropic'in halka arzı olacak. Şirketin yaklaşık 1,4 trilyon dolarlık değerleme hedeflediği, halka arzda hisse fiyatının 70-78 dolar aralığında belirlenmesinin beklendiği aktarıldı. Anthropic'in halka arzı, yapay zeka sektörüne yönelik yatırımcı iştahı açısından önemli bir sınav olarak görülüyor.

articles.title: Strive Uses Preferred Stock Sales to Fund $17.5M Bitcoin Purchase

articles.titleTr: Bir yıldır yerinde sayan gıda devinde yükseliş sinyali: Analist yüzde 25 potansiyel görüyor
articles.summaryTr: Kraft Heinz hisseleri son bir yılda neredeyse hiç değişim göstermezken teknik göstergeler toparlanmaya işaret ediyor. Jay Woods, hissede yüzde 25'e varan yükseliş potansiyeli bulunduğunu ve yüzde 6'nın üzerinde temettü getirisi sunduğunu belirtti.
articles.articleText: Bir yıldır yerinde sayan gıda devinde yükseliş sinyali: Analist yüzde 25 potansiyel görüyor - Kraft Heinz hisseleri son bir yılda neredeyse hiç değişim göstermezken teknik göstergeler toparlanmaya işaret ediyor. Jay Woods, hissede yüzde 25'e varan yükseliş potansiyeli bulunduğunu ve yüzde 6'nın üzerinde temettü getirisi sunduğunu belirtti. Kraft Mac & Cheese, Heinz Ketchup ve Philadelphia Cream Cheese gibi markalarıyla tanınan Kraft Heinz, borsada yeniden yatırımcıların radarına girmeye başladı. CNBC Pro yazarı ve teknik analist Jay Woods, şirketin hisselerinde uzun süredir devam eden düşüş eğiliminin ardından toparlanma sinyalleri gördüğünü belirterek yüzde 25'e varan yükseliş potansiyeline dikkat çekti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Woods'a göre hisse, son bir yılda neredeyse tam olarak aynı fiyat seviyesinde işlem görmesine rağmen teknik görünümünde önemli değişimler yaşadı. İki önemli hareketli ortalamanın üzerine çıktı Kraft Heinz hisseleri, Kasım 2024'ten itibaren düzenli bir düşüş eğilimi izledi. Uzun süre 200 günlük hareketli ortalamasının altında işlem gören ve 50 günlük ortalaması civarında seyreden hissede son dönemde görünüm değişti. Woods, hissenin hem 50 hem de 200 günlük hareketli ortalamaların üzerine çıktığını, uzun vadeli düşüş trendini de aştığını belirtti. Hisse fiyatının daha yüksek dip seviyeleri oluşturması ve kırdığı eski trendin üzerinde kalması, analiste göre olası bir dönüşün işaretleri arasında yer alıyor. İlk hedef 27,50 dolar, ardından 31 dolar Beş yıllık haftalık grafiği inceleyen Woods, uzun vadeli ana eğilimin halen aşağı yönlü olduğunu ancak mevcut teknik görünümün yükseliş için fırsat sunduğunu ifade etti. Analistin ilk yukarı yönlü hedefi, yaklaşık 27,50 dolar seviyesindeki 200 haftalık hareketli ortalama. Bu seviyeye ulaşılması, hisseyi temmuz ayındaki zirvelerine geri taşıyabilir. Bu ortalamanın da aşılması halinde 31 dolar seviyesi gündeme gelebilir. Woods, bu bölgede güçlü satış ilgisinin ortaya çıkabileceğini belirtti. 22 dolar seviyesi kritik Woods, yatırımcıların risk yönetimi açısından 22 dolar seviyesini yakından takip etmesi gerektiğini söyledi. Hissenin bu seviyeyi koruyamaması durumunda 21 doların zarar durdurma seviyesi olarak izlenmesini ve pozisyonun yeniden değerlendirilmesini önerdi. Analist, hızlı kazanç arayan yatırımcılar için bu görünümün çok cazip olmayabileceğini ancak sabırlı yatırımcıların toparlanmanın devamından yararlanabileceğini ifade etti. Kraft Heinz hisselerinin yüzde 6'nın üzerinde temettü getirisi sunduğuna da dikkat çeken Woods, yatırımcıların olası toparlanmayı beklerken temettü gelirinden de faydalanabileceğini belirtti. Woods'un Kraft Heinz hisselerini şahsen elinde bulundurduğu da açıklamada yer aldı.

articles.title: Forensic expert says his analysis of autopsy photos suggests Epstein was killed
articles.summary: Professor Michael Freeman tells BBC Newsnight that he believes the convicted sex offender's injuries are consistent with a homicide.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Forensic expert says his analysis of autopsy photos suggests Epstein was killed
articles.summaryTr: Professor Michael Freeman tells BBC Newsnight that he believes the convicted sex offender's injuries are consistent with a homicide.
articles.articleText: Forensic expert says his analysis of autopsy photos suggests Epstein was killed - Published This article contains distressing details and references to suicide A forensic expert has said he believes that convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein's death in prison was the result of a homicide, not suicide. Speaking to BBC Newsnight, Professor Michael Freeman said that after reviewing the New York City medical examiner's file he believes Epstein was strangled, most likely from behind. The medical examiner who carried out the autopsy concluded in 2019 that Epstein's injuries were consistent with suicide and there was no evidence of the defensive wounds expected if his death had been a homicide. Epstein was found dead in prison on 10 August 2019 in New York as he awaited trial on sex trafficking charges. Dr Barbara Sampson, chief medical examiner at the time of Epstein's autopsy, who ruled that Epstein's death was a suicide, has previously said: "I stand firmly behind our determination of the cause and manner of death for Mr. Epstein." The BBC has approached Sampson for further comment. Freeman has served as a cause-of-death expert to attorneys-general in the US for death in police custody cases, including George Floyd in Minnesota. He published his research and the New York City medical examiner's files after presenting his findings in London on Monday evening. Freeman, who did not see the body, based his conclusions on the files and photographs from the examiner's report provided to him by Epstein's brother, Mark Epstein, who has always maintained that his brother was murdered. Freeman said his analysis is independent and that he was not paid by Mark Epstein. His research has not been peer reviewed. He told the BBC that he believed there are signs indicating an assault on Epstein, including a deep haemorrhage to his left shoulder and injuries that appear to be consistent to being struck in the face. Freeman said he believed the evidence was most consistent with strangulation using a ligature and then that same ligature was probably used to suspend the body from the bunk bed. He said there appeared to be fingernail marks above the ligature mark on Epstein's neck, which "would be consistent with strangulation, particularly from behind. And the attempt by the victim to try to remove the ligature from the neck". He said "the injuries and the way the body was found don't match up. There's only one remaining explanation then, and that is that the death was as a result of a homicide." The medical examiner who performed the autopsy at the time told the Department of Justice (DoJ) Office of the Inspector General , externalthat Epstein's injuries were more consistent with, and indicative of, a suicide by hanging rather than homicide by strangulation, adding there was no evidence of defensive wounds consistent with what is seen in victims of strangulation. Freeman said he would have expected in an investigation of a death by hanging in custody for there to be a photograph before the body was taken down. According to a DoJ investigation into Epstein's time in prison, the guard who found Epstein immediately called for a second colleague to help, lowered Epstein's body to the floor and began attempts to resuscitate him. Epstein's death came a month after he was briefly placed on suicide watch, the DoJ report said. When asked who might have killed Epstein if his interpretation of the evidence was correct, Freeman said he had "no idea". "That is not something I have an opinion about. That isn't any part of any investigation that I've done," he said. Challenged on whether his views veered into conspiracy theory, Freeman said: "I have the luxury of being able to say, don't take my word for it, let everybody look at it." "If you think I'm still a conspiracy theorist because I'm looking at something that looks like a strangulation and say, I think it is a strangulation and I don't think it could be a hanging, show me where I got it wrong." "I'm wide open to that. I'm an academic. I'm quite happy to hear people's theories on things that are informed," he said. Epstein was convicted in 2008 of soliciting prostitution from a minor, for which he was registered as a sex offender. He escaped a heavy jail sentence as a result of a plea deal. Eleven years later, Epstein was charged with running a network of underage girls for sex. He was awaiting trial in 2019 when he was found dead at the Metropolitan Correctional Center in New York City. Related topics - Published2 February - Published12 August 2019

articles.articleText: Yatırımcılara iki hisse için kâr realizasyonu uyarısı: Geliri bu hissede değerlendirin! Jim Cramer, Nvidia ve Apple hisselerinde yüksek kazanç elde eden yatırımcılara pozisyonlarını azaltma çağrısı yaptı. Cramer, elde edilecek gelirin yapay zekâ rallisinin dışındaki daha defansif hisselere yönlendirilmesini önerdi. ABD borsalarında yatırımcılar, yapay zeka sektörünün geleceğine ilişkin iki önemli gelişmeye odaklanırken CNBC yorumcusu Jim Cramer’dan dikkat çeken bir portföy önerisi geldi. Cramer, Nvidia ve Apple hisselerinde yüksek kazanç elde eden yatırımcıların kârlarının bir bölümünü realize ederek farklı sektörlere yönelmesini tavsiye etti. Nvidia ve Apple pozisyonlarını azaltın Cramer, özellikle portföyünde Nvidia ve Apple hisselerinin ağırlığı yüksek olan yatırımcıların pozisyonlarını küçültmesi gerektiğini söyledi. Elde edilecek gelirin, yapay zekâ yatırımlarına daha az bağımlı ve daha defansif şirketlere aktarılmasını önerdi. CNBC Investing Club portföyünde de Apple pozisyonu pazartesi günü yüzde 5,5'ten yüzde 4,5'e düşürüldü. Hisselerin tüm zamanların en yüksek seviyelerine yakın işlem gördüğü sırada yapılan satışla yüzde 1.800'lük kazanç realize edildi. Cramer, Apple'ı uzun vadeli tutulabilecek bir hisse olarak değerlendirmeye devam ettiklerini ancak portföyde aşırı büyüyen pozisyonların disiplinli biçimde azaltılması gerektiğini belirtti. Nvidia için de şirketin CEO'su Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından geçen hafta kâr realizasyonu çağrısını yineledi. Apple ve Nvidia satışından gelen parayla Constellation Brands alın Cramer'ın değerlendirmesinde öne çıkan şirketlerden biri Constellation Brands oldu. Geçen hafta bu şirkette pozisyon açtıklarını hatırlatan Cramer, Modelo ve Corona markalarına yönelik talebin iyileştiğine dikkat çekti. Genel bira kategorisinde zayıflık yaşanmasına rağmen bu iki markanın pazar payı kazandığını belirten Cramer, Apple ve Nvidia satışlarından elde edilen paranın Constellation Brands hisselerine yönlendirilmesini önerdi. Intel satıldı, AMD portföye eklendi CNBC Investing Club portföyünde pazartesi günü bir başka önemli değişiklik daha yapıldı. Intel pozisyonundan çıkılarak elde edilen gelirle Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) hisselerinde yaklaşık yüzde 2 ağırlığında yeni pozisyon açıldı. Cramer, Intel'in veri merkezlerinde kullanılan merkezi işlem birimleri (CPU) pazarında rekabet edebilme kapasitesine ilişkin güvenini kaybettiğini söyledi. Yapay zekâ ajanlarının çalıştırılmasında CPU'ların öneminin giderek arttığına işaret etti. AMD'nin önemli avantajlarından birinin, işlemci üretimini veri merkezi ve zayıflayan kişisel bilgisayar pazarı arasında daha kolay kaydırabilmesi olduğunu belirten Cramer, Nvidia'daki belirsizliğin de AMD'nin grafik işlemci (GPU) pazarında pay kazanmasına fırsat yaratabileceğini ifade etti. news.title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
news.summary: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
news.summaryTr: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.
news.articleText: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda - Published Five EU countries will open a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda next year as part of a broader push to boost removals. Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands are expected to open a "return hub" ready to accept transfers in 2027, the Dutch and Danish governments announced in statements. The countries said the scheme would apply to migrants staying illegally in their nations who are subject to deportation, with the Dutch government adding it will provide an alternative if deportees cannot be returned to their country of origin. Deportees will be able to either integrate into Rwandan society or return to their home country, the nations said. The scheme will apply to people who have exhausted their legal avenues to stay in the five nations - unlike a scrapped British deal that envisaged sending people to Rwanda to have their claims processed. Legal challenges meant the UK deal never took off, and it was eventually junked by the incoming Labour government in 2024. Downing Street has not ruled out the UK joining the scheme, saying they will watch it "with interest". Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said the plan to open a centre in Rwanda had no "future or humanity", according to AFP news agency. "I don't see any future or humanity in that. It's not the solution," Sanchez told the Spanish broadcaster Telecinco, AFP reported. The five countries say the plan to send migrants abroad is in line with EU and international law, but human rights bodies say it could violate migrant rights. The deal follows a recent EU reform that allowed for the creation of hubs outside of the bloc. In a joint press conference in Vienna on Monday, Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker said the five countries wanted to relieve European asylum systems and stop traffickers arranging deadly trips across the Mediterranean. In a written statement, the Dutch government said the five countries will "only return single men" as part of the first phase of the deal, adding that the focus for the Netherlands "will be on persons from countries of origin in the same region as Rwanda". Once in Rwanda, people will be able to integrate into society, which means they will have the right of residence, as well as access to education, healthcare, the labour market and the legal system. Rwandan Interior Minister Vincent Biruta said the country is commmited to working with European partners to provide a "safe, legal and dignified solution for migrants". He added that they would also work on "correcting the global imbalance in economic opportunities", which he called a "key driver of irregular migration". Ahead of the announcement, diplomatic sources told the AFP news agency the hub is expected to initially run as a pilot, hosting about 100 people, with each of the five nations possibly sending about 20 migrants. The United Nations' International Organisation for Migration (IOM) could play an ancillary role. "IOM has a long history of providing assistance to migrants in situations of transit, including in complex contexts," an IOM spokesperson said, adding the agency was in discussions with some EU countries "on plans for the establishment of return hubs or similar mechanisms". With elections approaching in several EU nations, administrations have been under pressure to show they can control migration. Concerns around security, struggling economies and disillusionment with governing parties have all had a major role in shaping attitudes towards people leaving their home countries. Human Rights Watch's senior Africa researcher Clementine de Montjoye said the choice of Rwanda would be a cause of concern as it had a "well-established record of repression of dissent, arbitrary detention, ill-treatment in detention" and support for armed rebels in the neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo. "Paying Kigali to host a deportation programme would not only cause suffering and harm to those deported, it would finance and provide political leverage to a government responsible for serious human rights abuses at home and abroad." The independent EU Agency for Fundamental Rights argued any third country hosting a return hub should "respect fundamental rights", including that people should not be sent to a country where they face serious risk of persecution. The agency added that unaccompanied children should not be sent to a return hub, which the Dutch government has confirmed will not take place. According to the European Border and Coast Guard Agency, there were almost 110,000 irregular border crossings into the EU in the first 10 months of 2026, which represents a 29% decrease compared to the previous year. In October, about 18,100 crossings were detected, which is about 6% less than October 2025 but 22% more than in September "largely because of a sharp rise in arrivals on the Western African route to the Canary Islands". news.summaryTr: Chase Bank, the largest US bank, said a software bug might be causing the issue, but that it was not "systemic'" or "cyber-related".
news.articleText: Customers report service outages at major US banks - Published Thousands of customers at major US banks, including JP Morgan Chase, Wells Fargo and Bank of America, have reported trouble accessing services. Chase Bank - the largest banking institution in the US - said a "software bug" in its hardware systems may have been behind the glitch and noted the impacts may have affected other banks. It added the issue was "temporary" and not "systemic" or "cyber-related". Problems appeared to be easing for many customers by early Monday evening. The issue comes after a string of unrelated technical problems last week, including a massive Microsoft outage, as well as a telecommunications issue and network failure that grounded all US flights. Problems started throughout the afternoon on Monday. There were almost 5,000 reports of Chase Bank's services being down, according to the Downdetector website. Chase Bank told it's customers that "some transactions are taking longer than usual to complete" but they still had "access to their accounts and funds". The bank, a subsidiary of JP Morgan Chase, serves more than 86m customers at 5,000 branches across the US, as well as 7.4m small businesses, according to the company's webpage. It is also the top credit card issuer in the US. The exact nature of the bug was unclear. The BBC has contacted Chase Bank. Another institution, US Bank, said some its systems were not directly affected but clients using the Zelle, a digital payment platform, received error messages saying their payments could not be sent. Zelle has said its service is "operating as it should" and issues at other banks could be affecting payments. Customers also reported issues with Truist, PNC and Capital One but all these companies told the BBC they have not been impacted. As of 1800 ET (2300G), Chase, Bank of America and US Bank had seen a fall in the number of reported outages.

news.summary: Attorney General Rob Bonta alleges OpenAI misled and endangered the public

news.titleTr: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack
news.summaryTr: Attorney General Rob Bonta alleges OpenAI misled and endangered the public
news.articleText: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack - Published California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI on Monday, alleging the ChatGPT-maker misled and endangered the public by developing artificial intelligence (AI) models without proper safeguards. In the lawsuit, Bonta cited the July 2026 attack on the AI platform Hugging Face by experimental OpenAI agents which accessed the internet to breach that company's internal systems. Bonta claimed OpenAI created a public nuisance and violated the state's unfair competition laws. OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri told the BBC in a statement that Bonta's lawsuit "appears to single out OpenAI over a challenge that's been identified by every major AI lab". Other major AI developers including Anthropic, Meta, and Google have also said their models have staged similar attacks. But Bonta's lawsuit, filed in San Francisco, where the company is headquartered, appears to be the first such suit filed by a US state. Hundreds of OpenAI agents coordinated the Hugging Face attack over two days even though they were supposed to be contained in a safe testing environment. The incident drew added scrutiny because the agents went as far as attempting to cover their tracks. Bonta announced an investigation into the incident in September, and served an investigative subpoena on OpenAI as part of its probe. "The company knowingly tested a dangerous product without proper oversight or safety procedures and misled the public about it - this disregard for public safety violated California law," Bonta said in a statement on Monday. OpenAI said it has been transparent and responsive to the Attorney General's office. "We take misalignment seriously, and we have engaged - and will continue to engage - constructively with the Attorney General's office to share information and advance strong, practical safety standards for the entire industry," the company said. The company added that, since the Hugging Face incident, it has worked to understand and address "misaligned model activity" which industry figures often refer to as rogue agents. Nathan Calvin, chief strategy officer at AI safety campaign group Encode AI, said the lawsuit "recognises something we at Encode have long raised alarms about". "OpenAI and other companies developing frontier AI systems have safety and security practices that are insufficient to protect the public from risks that could be catastrophic," he said. news.title: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
news.summary: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.

news.titleTr: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
news.summaryTr: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.
news.articleText: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand. The United States Supreme Court on Monday declined to hear an appeal from crypto-focused bank Custodia, effectively ending the bank’s latest legal effort to gain direct access to the Federal Reserve’s payment system. Custodia is a Wyoming-chartered bank founded by Caitlin Long. The bank has been trying for a Fed master account since 2020, which would allow it to process payments directly without relying on third-party financial institutions. Now, the Supreme Court’s Monday decision means an earlier ruling allowing the Fed to reject applications from eligible banks will remain in effect. The case highlights some of the challenges crypto-facing banks face in gaining direct access to the US payment system. Still, even if state-chartered banks qualify for master accounts, the Fed does not have to approve every application. In a dissent issued in March, US Circuit Judge Timothy Tymkovich criticized the appeals court’s decision to give Federal Reserve banks discretion over master accounts. “Without a master account, a bank cannot operate in the modern banking system,” Tymkovich wrote, arguing that the ruling effectively gives the Fed the power to override state banking decisions. A timeline of events Custodia first sued the Federal Reserve in 2022 after waiting around two years for a decision on its master account application. The Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City ended up rejecting the request in January 2023, citing concerns about risks linked to the bank’s crypto-focused business model. In October 2025, a federal appeals court ruled against Custodia, finding that Federal Reserve banks did not have to grant master accounts to every eligible institution. Related: Crypto among sectors ‘debanked’ by 9 major banks: US regulator Cointelegraph previously reported that the court declined to reconsider its decision in March. This led Custodia to take its case to the Supreme Court. The bank’s appeal also received support from the Blockchain Association, which argued that the Fed’s ability to reject applications could weaken the authority of state banking regulators. Senator Cynthia Lummis and former Senator Patrick Toomey also filed a brief with the Supreme Court in August, supporting Custodia’s appeal. Today’s decision comes as other crypto-focused banks seek access to the Fed’s payment system. In March, Kraken Financial received approval for a restricted account from the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City — the same regional bank that rejected Custodia’s application. Notably, Kraken’s account was approved for an initial one-year period and allows it to send and receive payments through the Fed’s Fedwire system. However, the account has restrictions and does not offer all the services of a full master account. Looking ahead, Custodia may still be able to apply for another master account or seek limited access to the Fed’s payment system under a separate proposal. news.summaryTr: United Airlines, yaygın bir sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini açıkladı. Uçuş halindeki uçakların ve United Express seferlerinin etkilenmediği belirtilirken, şirket siber saldırı ihtimaline ilişkin bir bulgu olmadığını bildirdi.
news.articleText: ABD'de uçuş kabusu yeniden başladı: Havacılık devi United Airlines'ın sistemleri çöktü - United Airlines, yaygın bir sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini açıkladı. Uçuş halindeki uçakların ve United Express seferlerinin etkilenmediği belirtilirken, şirket siber saldırı ihtimaline ilişkin bir bulgu olmadığını bildirdi. ABD'li hava yolu şirketi United Airlines, pazartesi günü yaşanan geniş çaplı sistem arızasının kalkış yapacak uçuşları etkilediğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketten yapılan açıklamada, kalkış seferlerini etkileyen bir teknoloji sorununun giderilmesi için çalışmaların sürdüğü belirtildi. United Airlines, arızanın havada bulunan uçakları ve United Express uçuşlarını etkilemediğini bildirdi. Siber saldırı bulgusuna rastlanmadı United Airlines sözcüsü, yaşanan sistem kesintisinin bir siber saldırı olduğuna ilişkin herhangi bir bulgu bulunmadığını açıkladı. Şirket, sosyal medya platformu X üzerinden yaptığı paylaşımda teknik ekiplerin sistemleri mümkün olan en kısa sürede yeniden çalışır hale getirmek için yoğun çaba gösterdiğini belirtti. Yolculardan uçuş durumlarını düzenli olarak kontrol etmeleri istendi. ABD'de üç gün önce ülke genelinde uçuşlar durmuştu United Airlines'taki sistem arızası, ABD genelinde uçuşların dört saatten uzun süre durmasına neden olan ülke çapındaki yer durdurma kararından yalnızca üç gün sonra yaşandı. 13 Kasım'daki aksaklık, hafta sonu boyunca geniş çaplı uçuş gecikmelerine ve iptallerine yol açmıştı. ABD Ulaştırma Bakanı Sean Duffy, önceki kesintinin Arkansas'taki bir yönlendiricinin hava trafik kontrol sistemlerine radar ve diğer verileri ileten altyapıyı aşırı yüklemesinden kaynaklandığını söylemişti. Federal Havacılık İdaresi (FAA) yöneticisi Bryan Bedford ise bakır kablolardan fiber optik altyapıya geçiş için yapılan çalışmaların rutin bakım kapsamında gerçekleştirildiğini açıklamıştı. FlightAware verilerine göre pazartesi günü uçuş gecikmeleri ve iptalleri, pazar gününe kıyasla önemli ölçüde azaldı.

news.titleTr: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases
news.summaryTr: Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation.
news.articleText: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation. Germany’s lower house of parliament has passed a bill that would let customs authorities temporarily freeze cryptocurrency and other high-value assets suspected of having unlawful origins without first opening a criminal investigation. The Bundestag passed the customs reform bill on Friday as part of a wider effort to combat money laundering and organized crime. The proposed procedure would target assets worth more than 100,000 euros and explicitly mentions cryptocurrencies. Under the bill’s text approved by lawmakers, authorities would be able to hold assets for up to 30 days where there are factual indications of unlawful origins, according to a translated version. However, filing an application for confiscation could suspend those deadlines pending a court decision, and in contested cases, a court would have to be satisfied that the assets were of unlawful origin before ordering confiscation, effectively putting the burden of proof on the crypto holder. German Social Democratic Party lawmaker Ingo Vogel said that the powers would allow authorities to pursue suspicious assets even when there are not yet grounds to open a criminal case, according to the Bundestag’s summary of the debate on the bill. The bill still requires consent from the Bundesrat, Germany’s upper house of parliament, and is intended to take effect on Jan. 1, 2027. Lawyers challenge asset seizure powers Germany’s Federal Bar Association, known as BRAK, previously opposed the government’s draft in an Oct. 28 statement, warning that the meaning of unlawful origin is too vague and risks treating missing records as evidence of illicit wealth. The association pointed to assets inherited through generations as one example where owners may lack a paper trail. It also questioned what the administrative process would add to Germany’s existing criminal confiscation rules. German blockchain industry association Bundesblock also raised concerns about the treatment of digital assets in a March 31 submission on an earlier draft. It warned at the time that blockchain analysis should not automatically be treated as proof of ownership or control, and that incorrect wallet attribution could even infringe fundamental rights. As Cointelegraph reported, Saxony authorities sold 49,858 Bitcoin (BTC) linked to the Movie2k piracy investigation in 2024, raising about 2.6 billion euros, or $2.8 billion. At the time, prosecutors said the proceeds remained secured pending a court ruling on confiscation.
